formulas.name: Product2QueryFormula
formulas.expression: "SELECT Id, Name, Family, MS_FSM_Parent_Product_Name__c FROM Product2 WHERE Family= '" + TEXT({!LineItemAssetDataTable.firstSelectedRow.ProductFamily})+"'"+"AND Family != '" + ""+"'"

formulas.name: RelatedAssetQueryFormula
formulas.expression: "SELECT Id, Status, Name, MS_FSM_Run_Hours__c, MS_FSM_Parent_Tag__c, MS_FSM_Parent_Product_Family__c, MS_FSM_Asset_Placement__c, SerialNumber, ProductFamily, MS_FSM_Parent_Asset_Name__c, ParentId, RootAssetId FROM Asset WHERE RootAssetId = '" + {!Get_Work_Order.AssetId} + "' AND Status != 'Obsolete' AND (ProductFamily = '" + {!Product_Family_Filter} + "' OR ProductFamily = '')"
